name: operating-academy-recursive-self-improvement
description: Use when a lawfully selected Academy superintendent or an exactly bounded non-incumbent acting-lead mandate must improve the Academy itself from customer outcomes and operating evidence; run the Academy-owned MAPE-K, contract bounded advisory inference from LISS when useful, tender implementation as provider-neutral work, and admit only witnessed successor knowledge.
preconditions: the subject is the Union Officer Academy rather than a customer's formation territory
the Academy leading goal and value-adjustment law are resolvable
the monitor has exact Academy-local or admitted boundary evidence
supplier work will cross an explicit contract
postconditions: each MAPE stage is content-addressed and Academy-local
LISS completion or refusal remains advisory evidence with resource observations
software work is a provider-neutral lot until an actual provider bids and is awarded
software tender Questions remain clarification evidence and never become bids or awards
leadership-market publication binds one exact lot to five provider-authored member responses without claiming selection
an independent examiner admits or refuses learning
a successor knowledge epoch appends without rewriting prior epochs

records: AcademyLeadershipWorkLot and AcademyLeadershipTenderPublication when the superintendent market is opened
SoftwareDevelopmentTenderExchange when an advertised provider is solicited
